decisions.reason: Having remained in the portfolio for another year, this core-adjacent coolant-management extension appears inexpensive to carry and still offers upside, so the option value of keeping it open remains high.
The centrifuge fits the firm's filtration and process-media capabilities well, and continued market presence suggests enough promise to retain it while uncertainty resolves further.
Although the multi-model nozzle line could later be streamlined, it is close to the core offer and likely cheap to maintain, so management would keep the product line rather than exit it.
As a direct complement to the established chip-conveying portfolio and service business, the magnetic belt conveyor remains a strong, low-risk option to keep on the market.

The hinged belt conveyor still carries some overlap risk within the conveyor range, but after another year it likely justifies staying as a differentiated application-specific option rather than being abandoned.
